lines.speaker: Clinician
lines.text: How has your mood been over these past weeks?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.text: I have felt low and hopeless most days.

lines.speaker: Clinician
lines.text: And the things you usually enjoy?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.text: I stopped enjoying the evening walks I used to take.

lines.speaker: Clinician
lines.text: How long has that been going on?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.text: It has lasted more than a month, not just a short stretch.
